distinguishing_features: Implements localized pressure modulation via a compliant under-layer to reverse vacancy flux direction
Applies TRIZ P5 (defect-to-virtue) by converting void nucleation into a controlled buffer zone
Uses physics-based pressure gradient equations to calculate critical back-pressure thresholds
Introduces passive mechanical preload (5-10 MPa) as a failure-mitigation mechanism
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Preventing intermetallic Kirkendall voiding by actively reversing vacancy flux direction at high temperatures through mechanical pressure modulation
parsed.viable_reason: The compliant under-layer design and pressure-based vacancy flux reversal are physically plausible with existing materials and testable via SEM inspection.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The application of localized pressure modulation to reverse vacancy flux in intermetallic interfaces is not suggested by prior art focused on chemical dosing, thermal modeling, or wear monitoring.
